nodes.label: Vehicle Model and Technical Data Notes
Vehicle Catalog (src/data.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single catalog holds IDs, game prices and real specs; real values are not auto-applied to driving physics.

nodes.label: realSpecs.turkeyPriceTry
nodes.rationale: Real market price kept separately with note/date; only M4 Competition 2026 list price stored as reference since discontinued/kit cars lack verifiable single Turkish price (L120).

nodes.label: Game price (price)
nodes.rationale: Game prices set independently by starting balance and vehicle class (L120).

nodes.label: Lazy GLB loading on preview/switch
nodes.rationale: Not all catalog cars are loaded into memory at start; GLB loads on shop/garage preview or switching.

nodes.label: Procedural car fallback
nodes.rationale: Kept for broken or missing models.

nodes.label: Wheel rotation pivot system
nodes.rationale: Only named pivots (3DWheel Front/Rear L/R, bone_wheel_*_steer, rotation/steer) are bound; pivot centers are not invented from filenames, so merged-wheel models keep static wheels.

nodes.label: Model scale/centering normalization
nodes.rationale: Models fit to game scale by own length, centered horizontally, base on ground; does not alter real data or driving params.

nodes.label: Shop camera bounding-box fit
nodes.rationale: Camera distance adjusts to bbox and aspect ratio; car proportions not stretched.

nodes.label: modelRotationY: Math.PI
nodes.rationale: Reversed models (Audi RS3, SL65 Black) rotated 180 degrees.

nodes.label: Factory base specs for modified kits
nodes.rationale: Liberty Walk, M2 Motoring, Duke Dynamics, Varis GLBs show body only; engine swaps unproven so factory base specs referenced and flagged.

nodes.label: bmw_m3_gtr_-_nfs_mw.glb
nodes.rationale: Filename points at NFS Most Wanted look; specs taken from 2001 BMW ALMS race M3 GTR, not road homologation cars.
